title: 5 FREE airports just dropped in MSFS 2024! (plus Houston Hobby & Florence)
description:
If you're looking to challenge your approach skills and expand your route network, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just updated with a fantastic slate of new airfield arrivals. Whether you're flying heavy commercial ops into Houston Hobby, threading regional airliners past the historic hills of Florence, navigating dramatic Patagonian peaks beneath the Andes, or claiming five surprise $0 free airports across China and the US, this week's drop offers outstanding variety for airliner captains, corporate pilots, and regional flyers alike!

In this scenery breakdown, we inspect the latest airfield arrivals, terminal interior details, and custom terrain assets across the Americas, Europe, and Asia to help you decide what's claiming top priority on your virtual SSD:

✈️ MAJOR COMMERCIAL & EUROPEAN CULTURAL HUBS
We kick off in Texas with William P. Hobby Airport (KHOU) recreated by Fly 2 High for Flight Simulator 2024. Featuring fully modeled terminal architecture, custom aprons, detailed airside clutter, emergency vehicles, and complete landside street detail, this makes the perfect hub for busy domestic airline operations. Next, we head across the Atlantic to Tuscany for Florence Amerigo Vespucci Airport (LIRQ) by South Oak Corporation and Barelli MSFS Add-ons, bringing scheduled airline, bizjet, and general aviation capabilities right to the doorstep of Florence.

🏔️ SOUTH AMERICAN & SCENIC MOUNTAIN GATEWAYS
Down in Chilean Patagonia, Simulación Extrema delivers Puerto Natales Airport (SCNT), featuring 4K PBR surfaces, modeled terminal interiors, and custom hand-sculpted 3D mountain peaks across Torres del Paine National Park. We follow that with Resistencia International Airport (SARE) by TowerSoft in Argentina, sporting realistic surface wear, hangar facilities, custom jetways, and full GSX Pro compatibility.

🎁 5 FREE AIRPORTS TO CLAIM NOW ($0 MARKETPLACE FINDS)
Looking to expand your global route map without spending a dime? MSFSceneryBuilders has released five full airport packages in the Marketplace currently priced at $0:
• Hami Yizhou Airport (ZWHM) – Xinjiang, China
• Korla Licheng Airport (ZWKL) – Xinjiang, China
• Altay Xuedu International Airport (ZWAT) – Xinjiang, China
• Spirit of St. Louis Airport (KSUS) – Missouri, USA
• Owensboro–Daviess County Regional Airport (KOWB) – Kentucky, USA

Which of these new airfields are you loading into first? Flying domestic routes into Houston Hobby, taking in the mountain views at Puerto Natales, or grabbing those free regional airports before prices change? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 scenery additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
